1.content: H cells are static obstacles; the agent cannot enter them.

2.content: S cell marks the starting position of the agent.

3.content: G cell marks the goal location.

6.content: F cells represent free space; the agent can occupy these cells without receiving reward or penalty, and they remain static throughout an episode.

7.content: Moves are deterministic: an attempted move shifts the agent exactly one cell in the chosen cardinal direction. If the target cell is an obstacle (H) or lies outside the grid, the agent remains in its current cell and receives no reward.

8.content: Entering the goal cell G gives a reward of +1 and ends the episode. All other cells give a reward of 0 and do not end the episode.

10.content: The agent receives a complete view of the grid state at each timestep, including the types and positions of all cells (S, F, H, G).
